title: $T_{E,F}$ preserves bounded constructible complexes
statement:
For a prime $\ell$, a scheme $X$, finite extensions $E\le F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and
a bounded constructible complex $K$ of $E_X$-modules ([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]), the
complex $T_{E,F}K$ ([def-sfb-derived-extend-subfield]) is a bounded constructible complex of
$F_X$-modules.

proof.text:
Write $G_Z=F_Z\otimes_{E_Z}-$ for the coefficient inclusion [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map]. It preserves finite limits by [lem-sfb-subfield-flat] and finite colimits by [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], hence is exact. By [def-sfb-left-derived-exact], [def-sfb-derived-extend-subfield] and [lem-sfb-extend-scalars-preserves-homology],
$$H^q(T_{E,F}K)\cong G_X(H^qK).$$
The homology lemma's hypothesis holds on every scheme by the same flatness node; this does not require a bounded representative.

source.place: first sentence: exactness and the cohomology formula

proof.text: Let $M$ be a constructible $E_X$-module. By [def-sfb-constructible-module], choose a finite stratification with immersions $g_a:X_a\to X$ and presentation covers for the raw pullbacks $g_a^\natural M$. Apply [lem-sfb-subfield-extension-local-presentation] to each $g_a$. It gives local finite presentations of $g_a^\natural(G_XM)$ on precisely those covers. Thus the same finite stratification witnesses constructibility of $G_XM$, by [def-sfb-constructible-module].

source.place: Second sentence: apply preservation of pulled-back local presentations to every stratum.

proof.text: By [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], $H^qK$ is constructible for each $q$ and zero outside one finite interval. Step 2 and the isomorphism of step 1 give constructibility of $H^q(T_{E,F}K)$: compose its local-presentation isomorphisms with that isomorphism. Since $G_X$ preserves the initial object by [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], it sends zero to zero, so step 1 retains the same interval. These are exactly the two conditions in [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible].

proof_origin.place: First sentence (exactness and homology), local-presentation sentence (new pullback-local-presentation lemma), and final bounded-constructible assembly.
